project_type: Django 5.2 (ASGI/Daphne/Channels) backend + Vite/React 19 frontend, PWA + Capacitor Android
build_system: Backend: pip + pyproject.toml, no compile step. Frontend: Vite 8 (npm run build). Quirks: settings.py loads .env from repo root automatically; SQLite WAL in dev; InMemoryChannelLayer when REDIS_URL is empty.
test_framework: pytest + pytest-django + pytest-asyncio (backend only). No frontend test runner configured. Backend tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\pytest.exe
build_command: Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build | Backend check: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check
verification_instructions: 1. cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py check — must show 0 issues. 2. cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate --run-syncdb — must apply with no errors. 3. cd backend && .venv\Scripts\pytest.exe — all tests must pass. 4. cd frontend && npm run build — must produce no errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migrations under backend/*/migrations/ — generate with: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py makemigrations
environment_constraints: Windows dev machine. Backend venv at backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe. SQLite in dev — no PostgreSQL-only migration features. BREVO_SMTP_LOGIN not set in dev — email falls back to console backend. DATA_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE=5MB; FILE_UPLOAD_MAX_MEMORY_SIZE=5MB already set in settings.py.
contribution_requirements: Run manage.py check after every backend change. Existing auth (email/password + Google) must remain working. WS consumer must broadcast type field for new message types. Default='texte' on Message.type migration to preserve existing rows.
key_patterns: Backend views inherit APIView; throttle_scope set on view class. Services layer (services.py) contains business logic. serialiser_message() returns a dict consumed by WS and REST. Migrations are hand-authored or makemigrations-generated. Frontend: React Query for data fetching (useQuery/useInfiniteQuery/useMutation). WS events processed in TempsReel.jsx traiter(). CSS vars: --accent (orange), --accent-sec (teal), --bg, --carte, --bordure, --texte, --danger. Lucide-react for icons. api() from src/api/client.js for REST calls. Bouton/Champ from src/components/ui.jsx. Lazy routes in App.jsx.
directory_structure: backend/ — Django project root with venv at backend/.venv. Apps: comptes (auth/users), discussions (chat), profils, amis, publications, notifications, signalements. frontend/src/pages — page components. frontend/src/api — React Query hooks. frontend/src/temps-reel — WS hub. frontend/src/components/ui.jsx — shared Bouton/Champ/Marque. .env at repo root, auto-loaded by settings.py.
